scope: City plugin page: urbicana/pages/CityPlugin.tsx, urbicana/pages/CityTiles.tsx, urbicana/city-plugins.ts; rendered at /plugins/city-disciplines

findings.message: Each directory is a page section drawn as a floating card (Card with CardHeader and CardTitle).
findings.remediation: Draw the directory sections without a card around each; human review (hierarchy change).
findings.reference: openclaw-carapace SKILL.md, Interface Rules: "Avoid nested decorative cards and page sections styled as floating cards."

findings.message: At 375px, 8 contractor role names are cut with an ellipsis, short ones included ("Journeyman", "Site safety", "General contractor"): the home-page tile is sized for short app names.
findings.remediation: Let the role name use the row's width (no fixed tile column for long labels); human review (changes rendered content).
findings.reference: openclaw-carapace SKILL.md, Interface Rules: "Keep text within its container at supported viewport sizes."

findings.message: The page uses ClawHub's home-route anatomy (home-v2-apps tiles and tabs, home-v2-section-eyebrow) on the plugin route; it renders only because this build rule extends the home page's private --hv2-* tokens to .plugin-detail-page.
findings.remediation: Compose the plugin route from the plugin page's own or shared components instead of the home section's; human review.
findings.reference: openclaw-carapace SKILL.md, Interface Rules: "Compose shared classes from components.css before adding a one-off visual implementation."

findings.message: The professionals' roles show as bare codes (RA, PE, R, GC, PR, LA, S, L, P): their names come from dob_code_meanings, which holds them only after professionals_and_services_db PR #376 is deployed.
findings.remediation: Deploy PR #376; R, L and P stay codes until a DOB source defines them.

findings.message: The directory subtitle lowercases the acronym in contractor_licenses_nyc: "Contractor licenses nyc".
findings.remediation: Keep acronyms in capitals when spacing a register's name; human review (copy).
findings.reference: openclaw-design-audit rubric: copy/clarity; openclaw-brand: sentence case

findings.message: At 375px the city tabs row scrolls sideways: 3 of 6 tabs visible (668px of tabs in 335px). The page itself does not overflow; ClawHub's home section tabs scroll the same way.
findings.remediation: None required; noted for the review.
findings.reference: openclaw-carapace SKILL.md, Interface Rules: "Keep text within its container at supported viewport sizes."
